tagline: Your AI-powered path to the right college.
instructions_to_main_agent: Use React js (.js / .jsx files). Build an exceptionally sleek, high-trust Indian EdTech application for 'CollegePredict AI'. Adhere strictly to the color palette, typography, grid strategies, data-testid attributes, and interactive layout specs defined here. Avoid dark gradients or generic dark mode slop; keep backgrounds crisp light grey (#FAFAFC / #F8FAFC) with pure white (#FFFFFF) elevated surface cards, sharp borders (#E2E8F0), deep navy slate headings (#0F172A), and vibrant indigo accent (#4F46E5 / #6366F1). Ensure every page and component has data-testid attributes on key interactive and status elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navbars, modal overlays, and floating notification badges.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add specific transitions for hover/focus states like transition-colors or transition-transform.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Preserve natural left-to-right reading flow.
Always use modern button styles: pill-shaped or rounded-xl buttons with subtle hover lift (-translate-y-0.5) and focus rings.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖, 🧠, 💭, 💡, 🔮, 🎯 as icon assets. Use Lucide icons or dedicated React Icon packages.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, smooth transitions, tab underline slates, and staggered entrance animations.
Use generous spacing: p-6, p-8, gap-6, py-12 to py-20 for landing sections. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain/grid overlays, crisp border strokes (border border-slate-200), selection badges, and pulse indicators make the experience feel premium.
All interactive elements and critical state displays MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='predict-colleges-btn', data-testid='counselor-chat-input').

navigation.desktop_sidebar: Sticky side navigation on desktop with logo, user profile snippet, menu items with active state pill, and quick counselor trigger.
navigation.mobile_bottom_bar: Fixed bottom navigation bar on mobile with icons + labels: Home | Predict | Colleges | AI | Profile.
navigation.header_top: Top search bar with exam fast-filters, notification bell icon, and dark/light toggle if enabled.

key_components.description: Bold headline 'Which colleges can you get into?' with subhead, dual CTAs ('Predict My Colleges' primary, 'Talk to AI Counselor' outline secondary), live rank/percentile quick-search box, and interactive mini prediction dashboard visual.

5-step wizard with visual progress bar: Step 1: Academic (10th/12th marks, stream) -> Step 2: Exam (JEE Main/Advanced, NEET, MHT-CET, WBJEE, Rank/Percentile, Category, State) -> Step 3: Preferences (Preferred States, Branch/Stream, Budget, College Type) -> Step 4: Goals (Placement priority, Research, Higher studies) -> Step 5: Results preview.

Greeting 'Good morning, [Name]', Admission Readiness score circular gauge (e.g. 88%), My Predictions summary widgets (Dream: 4, Target: 12, Safe: 18), Upcoming Cutoff/Form Deadlines ticker, Recommended Colleges carousel, and AI Counselor Quick Advice widget.

Categorized tabs (All | Dream | Target | Safe) with college cards displaying logo, college name, NIRF rank, calculated probability badge (e.g., 85% Safe), round-wise cutoff comparison, annual fee, average placement package, and 'Shortlist' star action.
Facet sidebar filter by State, Exam Accepted, Fee Range, NIRF Rank, Facilities, Placement Avg, with search query bar and sort dropdown.
Detailed view for /college/:slug with sticky sub-tabs: Overview, Cutoffs (historical chart), Fees & Scholarships, Placements, Infrastructure, Reviews, and Admission Eligibility Predictor.
Up to 4 colleges matrix comparison with highlight differences switch, parameter rating bars (Fees, Placements, Infrastructure, Faculty), and an AI Summary recommendation box at the top.

Modern full-page conversational interface with prompt suggestions ('What branch can I get at NIT Trichy with rank 12000?', 'Show me top CSE colleges under 8 Lakhs fee'), real-time streaming response layout, inline rendered College Cards, and downloadable counseling summary.
Interactive Kanban or drag-and-drop lists with 3 columns: Dream, Target, Safe. Allows drag between tiers, note adding, and deadline reminder alerts.
Interactive timelines for joSAA/CSAB/State counseling rounds, ROI calculator slider (Total Fee vs Expected Avg Package), and scholarship finder.
Analytics over prediction searches, popular colleges queried, cutoff data uploader tool, user management table, and AI prompt template settings.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All buttons, inputs, tabs, cards, dropdowns, links, modals, user metrics, and navigation links MUST carry kebab-case data-testid attributes.
